summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a Form 6-K (Material Change Report) announcing that its Board of Directors appointed Jon Matonis as Chairman of the Board effective May 11, 2026, and Matonis resigned as Chief Economist effective May 12, 2026. Luis Berruga continues as a director. No deal terms apply; the change is a governance reshuffle. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 and is the US equivalent of a Canadian Material Change Report under Form 51-102F3. What to watch: whether this signals further strategic shifts following the recently announced acquisitions of Darklake's Zyga system and HoudiniSwap, and any impact on board oversight.
